vb_textbox.text: First thing to remember - PAIR THE COLOURS OF THE GNOMES.RED / PURPLE (pair 1) & GREEN / BROWN (pair 2)- when presented with the gnomes you will always have one from each pair 1/2 present in every round. For example, one red and one green. - Start with one pair being your selection, for example always selecting from the duo or RED/PURPLE- if you are getting 4+ points from that selection, stay with it until it drops to 2 or less, if this happens then flip to the other duo (green/brown)- you will notice the value of the coloured gnomes will chop and change, flip your selections with it regularly as there is no clear pattern when it will change. ** JUST REMEMBER **Work in duo's of RED/PURPLE & GREEN/BROWN
